h1: Instantly vs Smartlead.Compare the bill before you buy.
intro: Compare prices, contact limits, sending allowances and team access. See what the software includes and what mailboxes, domains and extra data add to the cost.
panel: A sending limit includes more than the first email.
Both entry plans leave out independent team access.
Mailboxes, domains and prospect data can change the bill.
quickAnswer: Start with Smartlead Base for a solo campaign: it costs less and holds more contacts. For teams, Smartlead Pro offers more contact storage; Instantly Hypergrowth allows more monthly sends. Both include CRM access.
resourceTitle: Five questions before you buy email software.
resourceIntro: Use this short brief when choosing a plan or reviewing a renewal.
resource:
1. How many contacts will we keep in campaigns at once?
2. How many emails will we send after counting follow-ups and replies?
3. Who needs to manage replies, and which plan gives each person access?
4. What will software, mailboxes, domains, data and client workspaces cost together?
5. Who will call suitable prospects and own the next step?
resourceAside: Keep the plan tied to the campaign.
resourceNote: Write down the contacts, people and monthly sends you actually expect. Review those numbers before buying more capacity.

Smartlead Pro holds 5,000 more contacts. Instantly Hypergrowth allows 35,000 more monthly sends. Test reply assignment with your team before choosing.

Instantly bills each workspace separately. Smartlead Pro plus three paid client spaces is $181 a month before mailboxes and data. Check which client permissions you need before building everything in one shared account.

The $174 monthly plan holds unlimited contacts but caps sending at 150,000 emails a month. Skip the upgrade if a lower tier holds your active list.

Instantly costs $358 a month; Smartlead Prime costs $379. Prime adds unlimited contact storage and three client spaces. Choose it if those extras replace costs you would otherwise pay.

faqs.a: Smartlead Base is a strong starting point for a solo campaign with an existing list. For teams, compare Smartlead Pro with Instantly Hypergrowth; both include CRM access. Instantly allows more monthly sends on that tier, while Smartlead Pro has more contact capacity.
The entry plans are $39 versus $47 a month. The first shared-team plans are $94 versus $107. Different contact and send limits, client spaces, mailboxes and data charges can change the total.

faqs.q: Are mailboxes included in unlimited email accounts?
faqs.a: No. Unlimited connections let you connect email accounts to the software. You still supply or purchase the mailboxes and domains used to send messages.

faqs.q: Do contact limits reset every month?
faqs.a: No. Instantly’s uploaded contact limit is campaign storage capacity. Smartlead counts unique contact addresses against the applicable storage limit. Monthly email-send allowances are separate from those contact limits.

faqs.q: Do follow-up emails use the sending allowance?
faqs.a: Yes. Include every planned follow-up when estimating sends. Smartlead also counts replies against email credits. Buying a higher allowance does not establish a suitable sending rate for each mailbox.

faqs.q: Which platform is better for agencies?
faqs.a: Compare client separation and access before choosing. Instantly requires a subscription for each workspace. Smartlead offers paid client workspaces from Pro, and Prime includes three. The less expensive setup depends on your clients, permissions and sending needs.

Run a small pilot with your sending setup. Review authentication, bounce rates, placement checks and genuine replies. Choose from those results; warmup and a higher send allowance do not guarantee inbox placement.

faqs.q: How can cold calling support an email campaign?
faqs.a: Use calls to reach suitable accounts, confirm who handles the decision and ask a relevant question. Give the caller the email context and record outcomes in the CRM. CallTeam can handle the calls, follow-up and meeting handoff.
